title: Screen ring and screen anatomy (E/O tiers)
description: Implement the v0.1 screen ring from spec 19 §5, §14: Boot→Status→Position→Last message→screensaver. Each screen shows one primary fact (§3). Status bar fixed at top with battery, GPS state, message-waiting count — same fields on every screen (§5). No chrome, no borders, no titles, no scroll indicators. Body uses largest readable weight. Data sources are CoAP resources from spec 17/18. No scrolling text ever (§3). Spans spec 19 requirements 5-7, 31-34, 73-74.
